description: Additional plausible source-based prophecy/fulfillment loci omitted from the original bounded inventory; these are unresearched leads and are not part of the completed 65 canonical cases. The list is preliminary and cannot be declared exhaustive.
provisional_inclusion_rule: Include an explicit earlier claim concerning a future state/event, a canonical later fulfillment/reuse claim, or a clear retrospective reinterpretation that communities present as prophecy. Distinguish each earlier source from each separately testable later use, track conditionality and literary dependence.
provisional_exclusions: Generic moral maxims, untethered poetic comparisons, and modern identifications lacking a specific biblical anchor do not automatically count as independent prophecies. Denominational canon boundaries still to be documented.
work_order: Verify exact primary passage and traditional verse numbering in a scholarly edition
Assess whether existing records directly cover the same source-plus-later-test pair and link rather than duplicate
Determine original authorial/historical context and composition-date evidence
Research later interpretations across Jewish/Christian/historical-critical traditions
Check independent history and uncertainty before creating a canonical case
